A_present_key.description: A cell counts only where the field is present on the record. The convention this practice used on 2026-09-08.

B_schema_plain.description: Every field in the schema is expected on every record, each counted equally. Ochoa & Duval eq. 1 as reproduced by Kiraly 2015; metadata-qa-api; Hillmann & Phipps obligation.

C_per_field_over_records.description: One rate per field, denominator the record count. Phillips, Zavalina & Tarver 2019; Tarver et al. 2015. Reported as a distribution, not one number.

D_no_ratio.description: Per-element occurrence counts, no denominator and no ratio at all. qa-catalogue.

E_weighted_by_obligation.description: Fields weighted by an obligation tier (mandatory/recommended/optional). Lorenzini et al. 2021; data.europa.eu MQA; F-UJI; Kiraly 2015 eq. 2.
E_weighted_by_obligation.why_not: The catalogue declares no application profile and no obligation tiers, so no weights exist to apply. The convention family cannot be run against it at all.
